observations: Blue industrial machine with a control panel and a large open chamber.
The machine appears to be a bottle forming or blow molding unit.

The machine is housed in a blue metal frame with a protective guard on the right.
The interior of the machine contains a complex array of mechanical arms and molds.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential components like the bottle feeder or the cooling system.
risks.proof: A photo of the complete machine with all accessories attached.

risks.risk: The machine may be a counterfeit or a generic clone of a high-end brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's nameplate or logo on the machine.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running and the forming arms in motion.
Photo of the manufacturer's nameplate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the machine with all accessories (feeder, molds, etc.) attached.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
